stickers.name: My boss
stickers.description: Nigerian comic-respect greeting. Boy bows head-to-ground, caption 'My boss'. Hail elders, customers, mentors, or the user as oga/chief/chairman — not a workplace title.

stickers.name: I greet you all
stickers.description: Formal group hello: 'I greet you all Group members'. Use when addressing a whole WhatsApp group, not a single DM.

stickers.name: Hi I am new here
stickers.description: Shy cartoon intro: 'Hi I am New Here'. First hello when joining a chat or meeting someone new.

stickers.name: I come in steeze
stickers.description: Swagger entrance: 'I come in Steeze'. Confident I'm-here energy, louder than new_here.

stickers.name: Gbam
stickers.description: Podium Pepe, 'Gbam'. Exactly / na so / the point just landed. Punchy agreement.

stickers.name: That's just it
stickers.description: Podium Pepe, 'That's just it'. Calm close: that is the whole point, nothing extra.

stickers.name: Na wa oo
stickers.description: Hands-on-hips Pepe, 'Na wa oo'. Standing Nigerian disbelief / this-one-is-something-else.

stickers.name: Nawa o
stickers.description: Pepe sitting on the grass, 'Nawa o'. Tired, heavier disbelief than standing na_wa.

stickers.name: Chai
stickers.description: Teary stickman, 'CHAI'. Pity, awe, and relatable pain — softer than na_wa.

stickers.name: Can u imagine
stickers.description: Grinning Pepe, 'Can u imagine'. Gossip/storytime disbelief, nosy not tired.

stickers.name: Wait what
stickers.description: Two-panel Pepe WAIT... WHAT? Double-take confusion before asking them to repeat.

stickers.name: Na you sabi
stickers.description: Toddler caption 'NA YOU SABI'. Unbothered your-call / I have said my own.

stickers.name: Sips garri
stickers.description: Pepe sipping, 'Sips Garri.' Spectator popcorn energy while drama unfolds.

stickers.name: I go discipline you
stickers.description: Side-eye blob, 'I go discipline you'. Fond Nigerian tease-scold, not real punishment.

stickers.name: No play
stickers.description: Mock-serious 'don't play with me' meme. Banter only — never real threats or violence.
